title: Gorp Promotion Record
description: Wave D contract. Immutable record of one successful promotion, written exactly once by `gorp promote` after the cherry-pick lands. Conflicted or blocked promotions produce no promotion record (they fail closed with no partial application). Linked to the approving decision by reviewDecisionSha256 and to the exact artifact by promotedCommit.

baseCommit.description: Target HEAD verified immediately before the cherry-pick (equals the graph's recorded baseCommit).

promotedCommit.description: The exact reviewed sandbox commit that was cherry-picked (the gate's artifactHash).

resultCommit.description: The commit created on the target branch by the cherry-pick.

reviewDecisionSha256.description: SHA-256 of the persisted review-decision file bytes at promotion time. Binds the promotion to the exact approval.
